page_title: Zappy: Free Screenshot & Recording Software for macOS | Zapier

sources.entry: Zappy - Zappy is a screenshot and screen recording app all in one. Has some simple editing tools built in.

summary.name: Zappy
summary.one_liner: Zappy is a free macOS app from Zapier for taking screenshots, recording screen videos and GIFs, annotating them, and sharing them with teammates.
use_cases: Uploading captures to get a shareable link
summary.what_it_does: Zappy lets you set a keyboard shortcut, then click and drag to capture any area of the screen. You can add colored text, arrows, and drawings to captures, with keyboard shortcuts for speed. Pressing Enter saves the capture to your computer. It also creates GIFs and screen recordings that can include audio, annotations, and a selfie view, and it can pin screenshots together into layered images. Past captures can be found and their links copied with a click.
notable: Cloud upload that copies a shareable URL to the clipboard
Records GIFs and screen videos with audio, annotations, and selfie view
Pin screenshots to build layered images
caveats: Automatic cloud upload and shareable URLs require a paid Zapier account
Only available for macOS according to the page
